dek: China's new-generation fusion devices are taking shape: the BEST compact fusion experiment in Hefei, targeting first electricity from fusion by 2030, and a field-reversed configuration device in Chengdu, the country's first linear-route fusion machine, slated to run by end-2026. Fusion startups raised over 7 billion yu
